entities.name: Abu Nasr Mansur
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Naṣr Manṣūr ibn ʿAlī ibn ʿIrāq al-Jaʿdī was a Persian Muslim mathematician and astronomer. He is well known for his work with the spherical sine law.
